input_normalization: Global Train-only Z-score; no per-trial initial-distance division
output_normalization: Train-only Z-score; predictions restored to mm
mlp_short_history: Causal left padding by first real value within each continuous sequence
lstm_short_history: Use all available real frames; no padding/repetition
state_policy: Reset at trial start, missing/invalid input OR target, nonconsecutive frame, nonpositive dt or dt>0.10s
physical_processing: No velocity, time normalization, per-trial amplitude normalization, smoothing or interpolation
